Connect your knowledge

Create a knowledge base and make documents available to your application.

Prepare your documents

Use a small set of relevant, current documents for your first test. Confirm that your workspace is allowed to use them and choose the appropriate sensitivity level. An administrator may need to configure an embedding model.

Create a knowledge base

  1. Open Knowledge and start creating a knowledge base.
  2. Choose files supported by the upload dialog. Follow the wizard to configure document processing and the embedding model.
  3. Submit the documents and wait for processing to finish. Upload completion alone does not mean the documents are searchable.
  4. Inspect document status. If processing fails, read the reported error and correct the file or configuration before retrying.

Use it in an application

  1. Open your application and select the knowledge base in its knowledge configuration. For a workflow, configure a knowledge-retrieval node.
  2. Save the draft and test a question whose answer is present in a document.
  3. Compare the response with the source. Also test a question that is not covered by the documents.

When answers are missing

Check that document processing has completed, the application uses the intended knowledge base, and the chosen model is available. Improve the source content or retrieval configuration before adding more documents.
